Class IndexStorageBarrel

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
src.IndexStorageBarrel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, Remote, IndexStorageBarrelInterface
public class IndexStorageBarrel extends UnicastRemoteObject implements IndexStorageBarrelInterface, Runnable
The `IndexStorageBarrel` class represents a storage barrel for indexing web pages. It implements the `IndexStorageBarrelInterface` and `Runnable` interfaces. This class is responsible for storing and synchronizing data related to web pages, maintaining an inverted index, and performing search operations on the indexed data. The `IndexStorageBarrel` class uses a multicast socket to receive packets containing web page data, processes the packets in a separate thread, and updates the internal data structures accordingly. The class also provides methods for searching web pages based on given terms, and retrieving the search results in a sorted manner based on the number of inbound links. The state of the `IndexStorageBarrel` object can be saved to a file and loaded from the file to maintain data persistence across multiple runs of the application. This class is designed to be used in a distributed system where multiple instances of `IndexStorageBarrel` can synchronize their data with each other to maintain a consistent view of the indexed web pages.

      This method represents the main logic of the IndexStorageBarrel thread. It continuously receives DatagramPackets from the socket and processes them. The method runs until the thread is interrupted or the executor service is shutdown.
